zh: 根据我的观察，我有一个很深的感觉，有史以来，没有一个差会、传道会、基督教团体、或大布道家，不盼望他们传道的门大开，但至终没有一个差会、传道会、基督教团体、或是大布道家，实现这个心愿。凯瑞威廉（William Carey）到印度，李文斯敦（David Livingstone）到非洲，戴德生（Hudson Taylor）到中国内地，都没有借着他们将福音传遍全地。然而今天向着主的恢复，全世界都开了。这一点不是夸大，若是我们有一千位弟兄姊妹，个个立刻都能被打发出去；因为欧洲开了，纽西兰开了，澳洲开了，甚至东欧、非洲、南美、中美都开了。来自全球各大洲的信，一封封都是和我们交通需要人去。然而人在哪里？即使仅仅为应付台湾，甚至台北的需要，我们都已经人手不足了，何况全地。人在哪里？（李常受文集一九八六年第二册，福乐的人生，第四篇）
en: Based on my observation, I have a deep feeling. Since the dawn of history there has never been a mission, an evangelical group, a Christian organization, or a great evangelist that did not want the door of the gospel to be opened to them; yet none of them has had their desire fulfilled. William Carey went to India, David Livingstone went to Africa, and Hudson Taylor went to inland China, but the gospel was not spread to the whole earth through them. However, today the whole world is opened to the Lord's recovery. This is not an exaggeration. If we have one thousand brothers and sisters, each one can immediately be sent out, because Western Europe is opened, New Zealand is opened, Australia is opened, and even Eastern Europe, Africa, South America, and Central America are all opened up. Every letter sent to us from the major continents all over the globe has fellowshipped with us regarding the need for people to go. But where are the people? We do not have enough people even to meet the need of Taiwan, or even just Taipei, not to mention the whole earth. Where are the people?

zh: 保罗在提后四章一节对提摩太说：“我在神并那将要审判活人死人的基督耶稣面前，凭着祂的显现和祂的国度，郑重地嘱咐你。”那是保罗将要殉道之时的劝勉。他说他美好的仗已经打过了。当跑的赛程已经跑尽了，当守的信仰也已经守住；在审判台前他必要得公义冠冕的赏赐；这冠冕也是赐给凡爱慕祂显现的人（提后四6~8）。他以审判和国度提醒提摩太，也提醒我仰，要过一个爱慕主显现的生活，这会叫我们不灰心、不退后、不软弱，忠心到底。
en: In 2 Timothy 4:1 Paul said to Timothy, "I solemnly charge you before God and Christ Jesus, who is about to judge the living and the dead, and by His appearing and His kingdom." This is an exhortation from Paul immediately before his martyrdom. He said that he had fought the good fight. He had finished the course, and he had kept the faith, and at the judgment seat he would be awarded the crown of righteousness, which would also be given to all those who have loved His appearing (2 Tim. 4:6-8). He reminded Timothy, and also us, by the Lord's judgment and kingdom that we should have a living that loves the Lord's appearing. This will cause us not to be discouraged, not to backslide, not to become weak, but to remain faithful to the end.

zh: 大卫是基督作王的预表。大卫的帐幕就是大卫的国和大卫的王室。当尼布甲尼撒来掳掠以色列国、蹂躏那地、焚烧城邑、毁坏圣殿、掳走君王的时候，大卫的国，他的王室就倒塌了（王下二五1~21）在阿摩司的预言里，神应许有一日，大卫的国和大卫的家要得着复兴，万国必称为耶和华名下的国。这预言指明，基督要回来作真大卫（赛九7，十六5，耶三十9，结三四23~24，三七24~25，何三5）并要重建（即恢复）祂先祖大卫的国，好复兴整个宇宙。那时大卫的国要成为基督和神的国，直到永远（启十一15）在复兴的国里，万国必称为耶和华名下的国，即万国必属于神。雅各在徒十五16~18引用阿摩司在11~12节的预言，印证彼得和保罗到外邦人那里去，因为在复兴的时候，所有的外邦人都要成为神的子民，就像犹太人一样。（圣经恢复本，摩九11注1）
en: David is a type of Christ as the King. The tabernacle of David is the kingdom of David and the royal family of David. That kingdom, that royal family, fell when Nebuchadnezzar came to capture the nation of Israel, devastate the land, burn the city, destroy the temple, and carry off the king (2 Kings 25:1-21). In Amos's prophecy God promised that in a certain day the kingdom of David and the family of David would be restored, and all the nations would be called by the name of Jehovah. This prophecy indicates that Christ will come back to be the real David (Isa. 9:7; 16:5; Jer. 30:9; Ezek. 34:23-24; 37:24-25; Hosea 3:5) and will rebuild, i.e., restore, the kingdom of His forefather David for the restoration of the entire universe. At that time the kingdom of David will become the kingdom of Christ and of God for eternity (Rev. 11:15). In the restored kingdom all the nations will be called by the name of Jehovah; i.e., all the nations will belong to God. Amos's prophecy in vv. 11-12 was quoted by James in Acts 15:16-18 to confirm Peter's and Paul's going to the Gentiles, because in the restoration all the Gentiles will become God's people, just as the Jews are.

zh: 千年国的两部分
en: The Two Parts of the Millennium
norm_zh: 千年国的两部分
norm_en: The Two Parts of the Millennium

zh: 在千年国里将有三班人。第一班是得胜的圣徒，包括新旧约中得胜的圣徒。这些得胜的圣徒要与基督一同作王，基督是至高的王，我们将是祂的小王。所以上部是千年国的君王部分。在下端部分的第二班人，乃是蒙保全正确的犹太人，他们要在主回来时得救。照着撒迦利亚十二章十至十四节，这些犹太人必仰望他们所扎的那位，然后他们要悔改。这些就是三分之一要经过火受熬炼的犹太人（亚十三9。）这些得救的犹太人要进入千年国作祭司，教导万民寻求神，认识神。那时以赛亚二章二至三节就应验了。三节说，“必有许多国的民前往，说，来吧，我们登耶和华的山，奔雅各神的殿；主必将祂的道教训我们，我们也要行祂的路；因为训诲必出于锡安，耶和华的言语，必出于耶路撒冷”。借着作祭司之犹太人的教导，万民都必认识神。以赛亚六十一章六节清楚的说，“你们倒要称为耶和华的祭司，人必称你们为我们神的仆役”。当千年国的时候，万民都必认犹太人为神的祭司，这话也就得应验了。
en: In the millennial kingdom there will be three peoples. The first are the overcoming saints, including those of both the Old Testament and the New Testament. These overcoming saints will be co-kings of Christ. Christ is the highest King, and we will be His sub-kings. Therefore, the upper section is the royal portion of the millennium. The second group, found in the lower section, is the preserved and proper Jews, who will be saved at the time of the Lord's coming back. According to Zechariah 12:10-14, these Jews will look on Him whom they have pierced, and then they will repent. These are the Jews who will be the third part who will pass through fire and be refined (Zech. 13:9). These saved Jews will enter into the millennium as priests and will teach the nations to seek God and to know Him. Isaiah 2:2-3 will be fulfilled at that time. Verse 3 says, "And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem." The nations will learn of God through the instruction of the Jews, who will be priests. Isaiah 61:6 clearly says, "But ye shall be named the Priests of the Lord: men shall call you the Ministers of our God." This word will also be fulfilled during the millennium, when the nations will recognize the Jews as God's priests.

en: Reign with Christ for a thousand years
norm_zh: 和基督一同作王一千年
norm_en: Reign with Christ for a thousand years

zh: 弥赛亚国是将来千年国的属地部分；天国（指天国的实现而言）是将来千年国的属天部分。弥赛亚国是属地的，天国是属天的。弥赛亚国尚未来到，天国（指天国的实际而言）已经在得胜的信徒身上了。弥赛亚国是为着将来得着复兴的犹太人，和那些作绵羊的外邦人的；天国是为教会中的得胜者的。将来的弥赛亚国，是犹太人所盼望的；将来的天国（指天国的实现而言）是信徒（得胜的）所该盼望的。将来在弥赛亚国里的，是作祭司的犹太人，和作百姓的外邦人；将来在天国里的，是作君王的得胜的信徒。在弥赛亚国里，有祭司，有百姓；但在将来的天国里，都是君王，没有百姓。将来天国里这些君王所管的百姓，就是弥赛亚国里的人。所以弥赛亚国，是将来天国的属治；将来的天国，是弥赛亚国的主管。教会中的得胜者，将来就是在天国里，和基督一同作王一千年，管治弥赛亚国里的犹太人和外邦人。（启二十4、6，太十九28，启二26。）（圣经要道（卷五），第四十八题）
en: The kingdom of Messiah is the earthly portion of the millennium; the kingdom of the heavens, that is, the manifestation of the kingdom of the heavens, is the heavenly portion in the millennium. The kingdom of Messiah is earthly; the kingdom of the heavens is heavenly. Before the kingdom of Messiah comes, the kingdom of the heavens, that is, the reality of the kingdom of the heavens, is already with the overcoming believers. The kingdom of Messiah is for the Jewish people to be restored in the future and for the Gentiles as "sheep"; the kingdom of the heavens is for the overcomers in the church. The future kingdom of Messiah is the expectation of the Jews; the future kingdom of the heavens, that is, the manifestation of the kingdom of the heavens, should be the expectation of the believers (the overcoming ones). In the kingdom of Messiah there will be the Jewish people as the priests and the Gentiles as the people; in the future kingdom of the heavens, there are only the kings and not the people. In the kingdom of Messiah there will be priests and people, but in the future kingdom of the heavens, all will be kings and there will be no people. The people to be ruled over by the kings in the future kingdom of the heavens are the ones who will be in the kingdom of Messiah. Therefore, the kingdom of Messiah is the subordinate of the future kingdom of the heavens; the future kingdom of the heavens is the ruling authority of the kingdom of Messiah. The overcomers in the church will reign with Christ for one thousand years in the kingdom of the heavens, ruling over the Jews and Gentiles in the kingdom of Messiah (Rev. 20:4, 6; Matt. 19:28; Rev. 2:26). (Essential Truths of the Bible, vol. 5, subject 48)

zh: “我又看见几个宝座，也有坐在上面的，并有审判的权柄赐给他们；我又看见那些因为给耶稣作见证，并为神之道被斩者的灵魂，和那没有拜过兽与兽像，也没有在额上和手上受过它印记之人的灵魂；他们都复活了，与基督一同作王一千年。这是头一次的复活。其余的死人还没有复活，直等那一千年完了。在头一次复活有分的，有福了，圣洁了；第二次的死在他们身上没有权柄；他们必作神和基督的祭司，并要与基督一同作王一千年”。这里告诉我们，掌权的是什么人，与基督一同作王一千年的是什么人。国度并不是为着所有的人，国度只是为着殉道者，为着弃绝撒但和敌基督的人。这样的人，才能作王一千年。所以只有殉道者才能作王，只有不接受撒但和敌基督的人才能作王。这就是证明给我们看见，人得着千年国，不是因着白白的恩赐，乃是因着在神面前有好行为。虽然在别的地方，我们看见还有别种的人作王，但是启示录给我们看见，必须有专一的义才能赴羔羊的筵席，必须为主殉道才能作王。如果没有专一的义，没有殉道，就与作王没有分。这是千年国。（倪柝声文集第二辑第九册，神的福音（卷二），第二十二篇）
en: "And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given to them. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus and because of the word of God, and of those who had not worshipped the beast nor his image, and had not received the mark on their forehead and on their hand; and they lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years. The rest of the dead did not live again until the thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection. Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection; over these the second death has no authority, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with Him for a thousand years." These verses tell us who will be the kings who reign with Christ a thousand years. The kingdom is not for everybody. The kingdom is only for the martyrs. It is only for those who reject Satan and Antichrist. Only these ones can reign for a thousand years. Hence, only the martyrs can reign; only those who reject Satan and Antichrist will be kings. This proves to us that the millennial kingdom is not given as a free gift, but is obtained through good works before God. Although in other passages we see other kinds of people reigning, in Revelation we see that there must be specific righteousness before there can be participation in the marriage feast of the Lamb. Only those who are the martyrs can be the kings. Without having the particular righteousness and without being martyred, no one can have a part in the kingship. This is the millennium.

zh: 启示录十五章说到在大灾难中受敌基督逼迫的殉道者，要在大灾难快结束时复活被提，站在玻璃海上（十五2~4，十三7上）掺杂着火的玻璃海是火湖的表号，所以这些殉道者是站在火湖之上。这些人是晚期的得胜者，他们经过大灾难，且胜了敌基督，没有敬拜他。他们要受敌基督的逼迫而殉道，然后复活，在千年国里与基督一同作王（二十4）当男孩子和初熟果子被提到三层天时，有许多信徒因为没有成熟而被留在地上。这指明他们所过的生活很少在基督里有长大，所以他们被留在地上经过大灾难。那将是他们的试炼，他们的试验，那会帮助他们放弃世界。倘若一位弟兄爱主，但仍然爱世界；当大灾难来临，得胜者被提时，这样一位弟兄还会爱世界么？他可能会喊说，“主耶稣啊，你为什么把我留在这里？与我一起事奉多年的某某弟兄已经被提了，但我仍然在这里”。这位弟兄必然会向主悔改，迫切的转向主。他不会想要留在地上直到大灾难的最后一日。这会使他成熟。大体圣徒的复活和被提，乃是在非常靠近大灾难结束的时候。甚至他们当中，也有些人要得着赏赐，因为他们经过大灾难而成熟了。在这次被提之后，主要在空中设立审判台，审判所有的信徒（林后五10）信徒或是要得着国度为赏赐一千年，或是要进入外面的黑暗里受惩治。（太二五21、23、30）（李常受文集一九九一至一九九二年第四册，得胜者，第六篇）
en: Revelation 15 speaks of the martyrs in the great tribulation under the persecution of Antichrist resurrected and raptured to stand on the glassy sea close to the end of the great tribulation (15:2-4; 13:7a). The glassy sea mingled with fire is a sign of the lake of fire, so these martyrs stand above the lake of fire. These are the late overcomers who will pass through the great tribulation and overcome Antichrist and the worshipping of Antichrist. They will be martyred under the persecution of Antichrist and then resurrected to reign with Christ in the millennium (20:4). When the man-child and the firstfruits are raptured to the third heaven, many believers will be left on the earth because they are not mature. This indicates that they lived a life with very little growth in Christ; therefore, they are left on the earth to pass through the great tribulation. That will be their trial, their testing, which will help them to give up the world. If a brother loves the Lord but still loves the world, when the great tribulation comes and the overcomers are raptured, will such a brother still love the world? He may cry out, 'Lord Jesus, why have You left me here? Brother So-and-so, who has served with me for many years, has been raptured, but I am still here.' This brother will surely repent to the Lord and desperately turn to Him. He will not want to remain on the earth until the last day of the great tribulation. This will cause him to mature. The resurrection and rapture of the majority of the saints will be very close to the end of the great tribulation. Even among them, some will receive a reward because they have matured by passing through the great tribulation. After this rapture, the Lord will set up the judgment seat in the air to judge all the believers (2 Cor. 5:10). The believers will either receive the kingdom as a reward for a thousand years or enter into the outer darkness to be disciplined (Matt. 25:21, 23, 30).

zh: 神在已过的永远里是单独的。但在启示录末了，祂有了一位新妇。启示录十九章给我们看见羔羊的婚娶和祂的婚筵。（启十九7~9）神有一位团体的妻子，这团体的妻子包括来自各支派、各方言、各民族、各邦国的人。（启五9）召会作基督的妻子这面，乃是终极完成于新耶路撒冷。神在她里面将得着完满爱的满足并极致彰显的安息，直到永永远远。（李常受文集一九九〇年第一册，使徒的教训，第十二篇）
en: In eternity past, God was single. But at the end of Revelation, He has a bride. Revelation 19 shows us the Lamb's marriage and His marriage dinner (Rev. 19:7-9). God has a corporate wife, and this corporate wife includes men from every tribe and tongue and people and nation (Rev. 5:9). The aspect of the church as the wife of Christ is ultimately consummated in the New Jerusalem. In her, God will have the fullest satisfaction in love and the utmost rest in expression forever and ever.

zh: 新耶路撒冷是所有旧约及新约时代得重生之圣徒的一个组合，他们凭着神建造在一起，作神永远的建筑；新耶路撒冷也是所有蒙救赎、重生、变化并得荣之三部分人，与经过过程并终极完成之三一神的调和。在成为肉体、钉死和复活里，三一神已经经过过程并终极完成，与人，就是祂所拣选的人成为一。历经神各时代里许多的世代，三部分的人已经蒙救赎、重生、变化并得荣，要与在已过的永远里拣选他们作祂配偶、住处并彰显的三一神，在将来的永远里成为一。
en: The New Jerusalem is a composition of all the regenerated saints of both the Old and New Testament ages, built together with God as God's eternal building; the New Jerusalem is also the mingling of all the redeemed, regenerated, transformed, and glorified tripartite people with the processed and consummated Triune God. In incarnation, crucifixion, and resurrection, the Triune God has been processed and consummated to be one with man, His chosen people. Through many generations in the various dispensations of God, the tripartite people have been redeemed, regenerated, transformed, and glorified to be one in eternity future with the Triune God, who chose them in eternity past to be His spouse, dwelling place, and expression.

norm_en: The New Jerusalem is a composition of all the regenerated saints of both the Old and New Testament ages built together with God as Gods eternal building the New Jerusalem is also the mingling of all the redeemed regenerated transformed and glorified tripartite people with the processed and consummated Triune God In incarnation crucifixion and resurrection the Triune God has been processed and consummated to be one with man His chosen people Through many generations in the various dispensations of God the tripartite people have been redeemed regenerated transformed and glorified to be one in eternity future with the Triune God who chose them in eternity past to be His spouse dwelling place and expression

zh: 根据新约的整个启示，基督徒工作的独一目标该是新耶路撒冷，就是神永远经纶终极的目标。……召会的堕落，主要的是由于这个事实：几乎所有的基督工人都被岔开，以新耶路撒冷之外的许多事物为他们的目标。因此，在召会的堕落下，我们要作一个得胜者答应主的呼召，就不仅需要胜过消极的事物，更需要胜过那些顶替新耶路撒冷为目标的积极的事物。那一种仅以救灵魂为目标的传福音，我们不要。我们传福音的目标，必须是新耶路撒冷。要成为得胜者，我们应当以神永远经纶的目标，就是新耶路撒冷，为独一无二且终极无比的目标。
en: According to the entire revelation of the New Testament, the unique goal of the Christian work should be the New Jerusalem, which is the ultimate goal of God's eternal economy... The degradation of the church is mainly due to this fact: almost all Christian workers have been distracted to take many things other than the New Jerusalem as their goal. Therefore, under the degradation of the church, for us to be overcomers to answer the Lord's calling, we need to overcome not only negative things but even more the positive things that replace the New Jerusalem as the goal. We do not want the kind of gospel preaching that has only the saving of souls as its goal. The goal of our gospel preaching must be the New Jerusalem. To be overcomers, we should take the goal of God's eternal economy, which is the New Jerusalem, as our unique and ultimate goal.

zh: 主在四章十四节下半说，“我所赐的水，要在他里面成为泉源，直涌入永远的生命”。父神是源，显在子神这泉里，涌流成为一道河，表征灵神。三一神涌流成为永远的生命，而这永远的生命有其总和。我们属人的生命也有其总和；一个活的人，就是属人生命的总和。神圣生命的总和乃是新耶路撒冷，就是这位涌流之三一神的目的地。约翰的着作所涵盖的，是从神直到新耶路撒冷。至终，这位三一、永远的神成了与我们众人合并的新耶路撒冷。我们不是进入新耶路撒冷，我们乃是成为新耶路撒冷。我们的成为，就是我们的进入。（李常受文集一九九四至一九九七年第四册，约翰福音结晶读经，第十五篇）
en: In 4:14b the Lord said, "The water that I will give him will become in him a fountain of water gushing up [springing up] into eternal life." God the Father is the fountain emerging in God the Son as a spring gushing up to be a river, signifying God the Spirit. The Triune God flows into eternal life, and the eternal life has its totality. Our human life also has its totality. A living person is the totality of the human life. The totality of the divine life is the New Jerusalem, which is the destination of the flowing Triune God. John's writings cover from God to the New Jerusalem. Eventually, this Triune, eternal God becomes the New Jerusalem incorporated with all of us. We do not enter the New Jerusalem; we become the New Jerusalem. Our becoming is our entering.
norm_zh: 主在四章十四节下半说我所赐的水要在他里面成为泉源直涌入永远的生命父神是源显在子神这泉里涌流成为一道河表征灵神三一神涌流成为永远的生命而这永远的生命有其总和我们属人的生命也有其总和一个活的人就是属人生命的总和神圣生命的总和乃是新耶路撒冷就是这位涌流之三一神的目的地约翰的着作所涵盖的是从神直到新耶路撒冷至终这位三一永远的神成了与我们众人合并的新耶路撒冷我们不是进入新耶路撒冷我们乃是成为新耶路撒冷我们的成为就是我们的进入李常受文集一九九四至一九九七年第四册约翰福音结晶读经第十五篇
norm_en: In 414b the Lord said The water that I will give him will become in him a fountain of water gushing up springing up into eternal life God the Father is the fountain emerging in God the Son as a spring gushing up to be a river signifying God the Spirit The Triune God flows into eternal life and the eternal life has its totality Our human life also has its totality A living person is the totality of the human life The totality of the divine life is the New Jerusalem which is the destination of the flowing Triune God Johns writings cover from God to the New Jerusalem Eventually this Triune eternal God becomes the New Jerusalem incorporated with all of us We do not enter the New Jerusalem we become the New Jerusalem Our becoming is our entering

zh: 新耶路撒冷有两种性情：人性与神性。按其人性说，新耶路撒冷是神在人间的帐幕─神在祂人性里在地上人间的居所。（启二一3）……新耶路撒冷是属人的居所，因为牠是由人性构成的。……按其神性说，新耶路撒冷是神的殿，作蒙祂救赎之选民的居所。（22）圣城是神的殿，因为祂是神圣的。……按其人性说，是人的帐幕；按其神性说，是神的殿。这是属人的居所，居住者却是神。神怎么能住在人的地方？因为祂成了一个人。同样的，我们人怎么能住在神的殿里？因为我们（在生命和性情上）成了神（但无分于神的神格）。这是神与人彼此互住。（李常受文集一九九四至一九九七年第三册，新耶路撒冷的解释应用于寻求的信徒，第一篇）
en: The New Jerusalem has two natures: humanity and divinity. According to its humanity, the New Jerusalem is the tabernacle of God among men—the dwelling place of God in His humanity among men on earth (Rev. 21:3)... The New Jerusalem is a human dwelling place because it is constituted of humanity... According to its divinity, the New Jerusalem is the temple of God as the dwelling place of His redeemed elect (v. 22). The holy city is the temple of God because He is divine... According to its humanity, it is a human tabernacle; according to its divinity, it is a divine temple. It is a human dwelling place, but the Dweller is God. How can God dwell in a human place? Because He became a man. In the same way, how can we humans dwell in God's temple? Because we have been made God (in life and in nature but not in the Godhead). This is the mutual abiding of God and man.

zh: 新耶路撒冷是宇宙的对耦神圣罗曼史的完成
en: The New Jerusalem is the consummation of the divine romance of the universal couple.
norm_zh: 新耶路撒冷是宇宙的对耦神圣罗曼史的完成
norm_en: The New Jerusalem is the consummation of the divine romance of the universal couple

zh: 按其人性说，新耶路撒冷是羔羊─救赎之神─的人性妻子，有神的生命和性情。（启二一2、9）这属人的妻子能与神圣的人位成为婚配，因为她有神圣的生命和性情。这使她有资格与救赎的神相配。一面，她是属人的；但另一面，她是神圣的。因为她是属人的，她就能成为救赎之神的人性妻子。因为她是神圣的，她就能与祂这神圣的人位成为婚配。按其神性说，这城是蒙神救赎之选民的神性丈夫（救赎之神在祂终极完成的具体化身基督里，有人的生命和性情）。妻子是属人的，丈夫是神圣的。属人的妻子怎么能与神圣的人位成为婚配？因为她有神圣人位的神圣性情和生命。同一个实体怎么能又是丈夫？因为新耶路撒冷是神圣的，神圣的神乃是其构成的一部分。所以，新耶路撒冷一面是妻子，另一面又是丈夫。新耶路撒冷按其人性说是妻子，按其神性说乃是丈夫。但作为神圣的丈夫，新耶路撒冷有属人的生命的性情。在其人性和神性里，新耶路撒冷乃是一个相互的住处，也是一对配偶，一对夫妇。（李常受文集一九九四至一九九七年第三册，新耶路撒冷的解释应用于寻求的信徒，第一篇）
en: According to its humanity, the New Jerusalem is the human wife of the Lamb—the redeeming God—with the divine life and nature (Rev. 21:2, 9). This human wife can marry the divine Person because she has the divine life and nature. This qualifies her to be matched with the redeeming God. On the one hand, she is human, but on the other hand, she is divine. Because she is human, she can be the human wife of the redeeming God. Because she is divine, she can marry Him, the divine Person. According to its divinity, it is the divine Husband (the redeeming God in His consummated embodiment, Christ, with the human life and nature) of God's redeemed elect. The wife is human, and the Husband is divine. How can a human wife marry a divine Person? Because she has the divine Person's divine nature and life. How can the same entity also be a husband? Because the New Jerusalem is divine. The divine God is a part of its constituent. Therefore, on the one hand, it is a wife. On the other hand, it is a husband. The New Jerusalem is the wife according to its humanity and the husband according to its divinity. But as the divine Husband, the New Jerusalem has the human life and nature. In its humanity and in its divinity it is both a mutual abode and a couple, a wife and a husband.

zh: 新耶路撒冷是神与人终极的合并
en: The New Jerusalem is the consummate incorporation of God and man
norm_zh: 新耶路撒冷是神与人终极的合并
norm_en: The New Jerusalem is the consummate incorporation of God and man

zh: 在我们的职事里，我们用了三个辞来描述信徒与三一神的关系：联结（union）、调和（mingling）、合并（incorporation）。……“联结”关系到我们与主在生命上的一。“调和”与神圣的性情和属人的性情有关。主又进一步给我们看见，我们与祂的关系不只是联结与调和，更是合并。
en: In our ministry we have used three words to describe the relationship of the believers with the Triune God: union, mingling, and incorporation. ... "Union" concerns our oneness with the Lord in life. "Mingling" has to do with the divine nature and the human nature. The Lord has further shown us that our relationship with Him is not only a union and a mingling but also an incorporation.
norm_zh: 在我们的职事里我们用了三个辞来描述信徒与三一神的关系联结union调和mingling合并incorporation联结关系到我们与主在生命上的一调和与神圣的性情和属人的性情有关主又进一步给我们看见我们与祂的关系不只是联结与调和更是合并
norm_en: In our ministry we have used three words to describe the relationship of the believers with the Triune God union mingling and incorporation Union concerns our oneness with the Lord in life Mingling has to do with the divine nature and the human nature The Lord has further shown us that our relationship with Him is not only a union and a mingling but also an incorporation

zh: 联结与调和是指我们与主在生命和性情上（但不是在人位上）的关系。按着人而言，没有一个人能在另一个人里面。但在神圣奥秘的范围里，终极完成的神与得重生的信徒，这些人位乃是彼此内住的。这就是合并。在这宇宙、神圣且属人的合并里，有一些人位住在彼此里面，也就是互相内住。
en: Union and mingling refer to our relationship with the Lord in our life and nature but not in our person. Humanly speaking, no person can be in another person. But in the divine and mystical realm, the consummated God and the regenerated believers, the persons, indwell one another. This is an incorporation. In this universal, divine-human incorporation, persons indwell one another, that is, they coinhere.

zh: “合并”一辞也指明这些人位合并一起以完成其目的，就是完成神的经纶。……神经纶的目标乃是终极完成的神与重生信徒扩大的、宇宙的、神人二性的合并。……所有信徒至终都要合并到这一个伟大的合并里。这宇宙合并最终的完成乃是新耶路撒冷。（李常受文集一九九四至一九九七年第五册，基督为父用神圣的荣耀所荣耀的结果，第五篇）
en: The word "incorporation" also indicates that these persons are incorporated together to carry out their purpose, that is, to carry out God's economy. ... The goal of God's economy is the enlarged, universal, divine-human incorporation of the consummated God with the regenerated believers. ... Eventually, all the believers will be incorporated into this one great incorporation. The ultimate consummation of this universal incorporation is the New Jerusalem.

zh: 这是神的创造，这是神的成为肉体，这也是我们的悔改得救。六千年前祂创造我们，二千年前祂来成为我们，今天祂进到我们里面。因此，我们是祂的一部分。我们是祂的配偶。神的配偶就是神的一部分。祂所是的，我们就是。祂是头，我们是身体。我们不能说，头是神而身体不是神。身体与头乃是一，且是相同的。基督徒不仅是有最高道德标准的人。作基督徒就是成为神，成为神的一部分，成为神的配偶。我们既是基督徒，就该借着在灵里、照着灵行事并作每一件事，来活神、彰显神、并显大神。我们成了这位神的配偶，祂乃是赐生命、复合、包罗万有的灵，这灵就是经过过程之三一神的终极完成、总和、集大成。在耶稣基督里，这样一位灵乃是赐给地上万国的大福。（李常受文集一九九三年第二册，在神与人关系里生机的联结，第二篇）
en: This is God's creation, this is God's incarnation, and this is also our repentance and salvation. Six thousand years ago He created us, two thousand years ago He came to become us, and today He enters into us. Therefore, we are a part of Him. We are His counterpart. God's counterpart is a part of God. What He is, we are. He is the Head, and we are the body. We cannot say that the Head is God but the body is not God. The body and the Head are one and are the same. Christians are not only those who have the highest standard of morality. To be a Christian is to become God, to become a part of God, and to become God's counterpart. Since we are Christians, we should live God, express God, and magnify God by walking and doing everything in the spirit and according to the spirit. We have become the counterpart of this God, who is the life-giving, compounded, all-inclusive Spirit, and this Spirit is the consummation, the totality, and the aggregate of the processed Triune God. In Jesus Christ, such a Spirit is the great blessing given to all the nations of the earth.

zh: 祂虽是无罪的，但当祂在十字架上时，神竟然离弃了祂。因为在这时，祂身上担当着我们众人所有的罪，在神看来，祂就是个罪人，是极大的罪人，是完全的罪人，所以神离弃了祂。虽然祂自己是无罪的，是不知罪的，但神把我们众人的罪都归在祂身上（赛五三6下），以祂为我们的赎罪祭和赎愆祭（10上），要祂替我们担当罪。所以在这时，神不只离弃了祂，并且击打祂，责罚祂，将祂压伤（5），使祂受死的痛苦，为我们尝尽死味（来二9），好使神的公义在我们身上的要求得到满足。神是叫祂那义的代替我们这不义的（彼前三18），为要使我们在神面前得蒙救赎，而成为义的（赛五三11）。
en: He was sinless, but God forsook Him on the cross because He bore our iniquity. In the eyes of God Christ was a sinner on the cross. Although He was sinless and did not know sin, at the cross God caused the iniquity of us all to fall on Him (Isa. 53:6b), making Him our sin offering and trespass offering (v. 10a) so that He could bear our sins on our behalf. Hence, God not only forsook Him but also smote Him, afflicted Him, and crushed Him (v. 5) so that He might suffer the pain of death and taste death on our behalf (Heb. 2:9) in order that the requirements of God's righteousness might be fulfilled in us. God caused the Righteous to suffer on behalf of the unrighteous (1 Pet. 3:18) so that He could redeem us and make us righteous (Isa. 53:11).

zh: 我们与基督联合，神是把我们算在基督里面。神不单独地看我们，神是在基督里看我们。在基督里，神看我们已经和基督同死了。所以，神在祂的话里清楚启示，我们在基督里属基督的人，肉体、旧人和自己都已经与基督同钉十字架（罗六6，加二20，五24）。在神看来，我们已经和基督同钉十字架了，已经在基督里和祂同死。不只是我们的罪在基督的十字架上解决了，连我们这个人也在基督的十字架上解决了。
en: We are joined to Christ; hence, God considers us as being in Christ. God does not see us apart from Christ; He sees us in Christ. In God's eyes we died with Christ. The Word of God reveals that the flesh, the old man, and the self of those who are in Christ have been crucified with Christ (Rom. 6:6; Gal. 2:20; 5:24). In God's eyes, we have been crucified with Christ, and we have died with Him. In addition to our sins, the cross of Christ dealt with our person as well.

zh: 我们已经看过，撒但引诱人堕落时，他自己也进到了人里面。从那时起，他就在堕落的人里面，和人调在一起。所以，当主耶稣在十字架上，用祂的死解决人自己时，也就解决了在人里面的撒但。因此，当主耶稣要到十字架上受死前，祂曾说，“这世界的王要被赶出去。”（约十二31）这世界的王就是撒但，他调在人里面，霸占人，辖制人。主到十字架上，用祂的死解决了撒但所调在里面而霸占的人，自然也解决了这调在人里面而霸占人的撒但。所以圣经才说，主是借着死，就是十字架上的死，毁坏了撒但（来二14）。当初撒但借着引诱人堕落而进到人里头，以为他的诡计得逞，其实是弄巧成拙，反而给神得着机会对付他，解决他。撒但以为他将人骗去，可以霸占人作他的居所，其实他所骗去的人是他的陷阱，使他落到神的审判和毁坏里。神就是在撒但所骗去而霸占的人里面，审判了撒但，毁坏了撒但。
en: We have already seen that Satan entered into man when he enticed man to sin. He has been in man since the time of the fall, and his satanic nature is mixed with the fallen human nature. Thus, when the Lord Jesus dealt with man in His death on the cross, He dealt with the Satan who was in man. Before the Lord Jesus died on the cross, He said, "Now shall the ruler of this world be cast out" (John 12:31). The ruler of this world is Satan, whose sinful nature is mixed with fallen man and who has usurped fallen man. Our co-crucifixion with the Lord on the cross dealt with the fallen human nature, which is mixed with Satan and usurped by Satan. Hence, the Lord also dealt with Satan, who was mixed with man and who had usurped man. The Bible says that the Lord destroyed Satan through His death on the cross (Heb. 2:14). Seemingly, Satan was victorious when he entered into man by enticing man to sin. However, this was Satan's downfall, because this gave God the opportunity to deal with him. Satan thought that he could trick man and usurp man by indwelling man as sin, but he was ensnared in man and able to be put under God's judgment and destruction. God judged and destroyed Satan in man, whom Satan had tricked and usurped.

zh: 当我们这被撒但骗去，跟从他犯罪、顶撞神的人，在主的十字架上，借着主的死，受神审判并治死时，撒但也在我们里面受了神的审判和毁坏。不只如此，还有撒但手下的使者，就是诸天界里那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这黑暗世界的以及诸天界里那邪恶的属灵势力（弗六12），也和撒但一同受了神的审判和毁坏。撒但既是他们的首领（二2），他们既是跟随他的，撒但受了神的审判和毁坏，当然他们也与撒但一同受了神的审判和毁坏。所以撒但和他的使者，也是主的十字架所解决的。主的十字架毁坏了那黑暗的君王撒但，也毁坏了他黑暗的国度，并其中一切执政的、掌权的。这是许多信徒不太知道的，但是撒但和他的使者，就是他黑暗国度里的鬼，却十分清楚。当我们赶鬼的时候，我们就能知道，主的十字架在鬼身上是何等有权能。我们在属灵的争战里，能经历主的十字架与祂所流的血叫我们胜过撒但（启十二11），使撒但和他的使者蒙羞，不能站立。
en: When we, who were tricked by Satan into following him to sin and oppose God, were judged and put to death by God through the Lord's death on the cross, Satan was judged and destroyed by God in us as well. Furthermore, the angels under Satan—the rulers, the authorities, the world-rulers of this darkness, the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenlies—were also judged and destroyed with Satan by God (Eph. 6:12). Since Satan is their ruler (2:2) and they follow him, when Satan was judged and destroyed, of course they also were judged and destroyed with Satan. Therefore, Satan and his angels were also dealt with by the cross of Christ. The cross destroyed Satan, the ruler of this darkness, as well as his kingdom of darkness with its rulers and authorities. Not many believers know this fact, but Satan, his angels, and the demons in his kingdom of darkness are well aware of this matter. We know the power of the Lord's cross when we cast out demons. In spiritual warfare we can overcome Satan when we experience the Lord's cross and His shed blood (Rev. 12:11), causing Satan and his angels to be put to shame and unable to stand.

zh: 主的十字架怎样审判并毁坏了撒但，也照样审判并毁坏了撒但所管辖的世界。这个顶撞神的世界是属于撒但的，是挂在撒但身上的。撒但既在主的十字架上受了审判并毁坏，自然挂在他身上的世界也就和他一同受了审判并毁坏。在神面前，世界是已经在十字架上受了审判并毁坏（约十六11）。在有神眼光的人跟前，世界也是已经钉在十字架上，被解决了（加六14）。
en: Just as the Lord's cross judged and destroyed Satan, it also judged and destroyed the world ruled by Satan. This God-opposing world is of Satan, and it hangs upon him. Since Satan has been judged and destroyed on the Lord's cross, naturally the world that hangs upon him has also been judged and destroyed with him. Before God, the world has already been judged and destroyed on the cross (John 16:11). In the eyes of those who have God's view, the world also has been crucified and dealt with (Gal. 6:14).

zh: 主释放生命，分赐生命这面的死，是当日亚当沉睡所预表的。当日神使亚当睡一觉，肋旁裂开，产生了夏娃（创二21~22）。照样，神也使主在十字架上睡了一觉，在十字架上受死，肋旁裂开，流出血和水（约十九34），使人得着祂的生命，就是神的生命，而产生召会。
en: The life-releasing aspect, the life-imparting aspect, of the Lord's death is typified by Adam's deep sleep. God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and He took out one of Adam's ribs. Then God built Eve out of the rib that He had taken from Adam's side (Gen. 2:21-22). Similarly, God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the Lord Jesus when He died on the cross so that blood and water could flow out of His pierced side (John 19:34). Now the life of God is available to man in order to produce the church.

zh: 在十七节保罗有力的说到一个饼和一个身体：“因着只有一个饼，我们虽多，还是一个身体，因我们都分受这一个饼”。这一个饼，乃是象征基督那是一的身体。我们众人是这一个身体，因为我们都分受这一个饼。我们一同分受这一个饼，使我们众人成为一。这指明我们有分于基督，就使我们众人成为祂的一个身体。我们众人所分受的这位基督，把我们构成祂的一个身体。分受（即吃─28~30）这一个饼，使我们与这饼联合为一。这指明我们有分于基督、享受基督，使我们与祂联合为一，与祂成为一。（哥林多前书生命读经，第四十九篇）
en: In verse 17 Paul speaks strongly of one bread and one Body: "Seeing that there is one bread, we who are many are one Body; for we all partake of the one bread." The one bread signifies the one Body of Christ. We all are one Body because we all partake of the one bread. Our joint partaking of the one bread makes us all one. This indicates that our partaking of Christ makes us all His one Body. The very Christ of whom we all partake constitutes us His one Body. Partaking of (that is, eating—vv. 28-30) this one bread makes us one with the bread. This indicates that our partaking of Christ, our enjoying of Christ, makes us one with Him, to be one with Him.

zh: 圣灵（就是终极完成的三一神）的浇灌是为着将所有信徒浸成一个身体。所有的信徒，无论在时间或空间上，都普遍的在那灵的这个浇灌里浸成了一个身体。这一个身体包含许多项目：基督的身体、基督的新妇、宇宙的新人、神的家人、神的殿、召会和国度。头三个项目—基督的身体、基督的新妇、和宇宙的新人—与基督有关。末四个项目—神的家人、神的殿、召会、和国度—与神有关。（李常受文集一九九〇年第一册，使徒的教训，第五篇）
en: The outpouring of the Holy Spirit as the consummated Triune God was for the baptizing of all the believers into one Body. All the believers universally, in space and in time, were baptized in this outpouring of the Spirit into one Body. This one Body comprises a number of items: the Body of Christ, the bride of Christ, the universal new man, the household of God, the temple of God, the church, and the kingdom. The first three items—the Body of Christ, the bride of Christ, and the universal new man—are related to Christ. The last four items—the household of God, the temple of God, the church, and the kingdom—are related to God.
norm_zh: 圣灵就是终极完成的三一神的浇灌是为着将所有信徒浸成一个身体所有的信徒无论在时间或空间上都普遍的在哪灵的这个浇灌里浸成了一个身体这一个身体包含许多项目基督的身体基督的新妇宇宙的新人神的家人神的殿召会和国度头三个项目基督的身体基督的新妇和宇宙的新人与基督有关末四个项目神的家人神的殿召会和国度与神有关李常受文集一九九〇年第一册使徒的教训第五篇
norm_en: The outpouring of the Holy Spirit as the consummated Triune God was for the baptizing of all the believers into one Body All the believers universally in space and in time were baptized in this outpouring of the Spirit into one Body This one Body comprises a number of items the Body of Christ the bride of Christ the universal new man the household of God the temple of God the church and the kingdom The first three itemsthe Body of Christ the bride of Christ and the universal new manare related to Christ The last four itemsthe household of God the temple of God the church and the kingdomare related to God

zh: 祂这三一神把自己浇灌在所有信祂的人身上，这些人包括犹太人、外邦人、古时的信徒、和现今的信徒。我们都在这终极完成的灵里，就是在三一神终极的完成里受浸，并且都浸成一个身体。所有信徒浸成一个宇宙的身体，是浸的团体一面。除了这一面，还有个人的一面，就是团体之浸的应用、实化和有分。（徒十47~48，二38、41，十六33，十九5，太二八19，加三27~28。）
en: He, this Triune God, poured Himself out upon all who believe in Him, who include the Jews, the Gentiles, the ancient believers, and the present believers. We all have been baptized in this consummated Spirit, that is, in the ultimate consummation of the Triune God, and have all been baptized into one Body. The baptizing of all the believers into one Body universally is the corporate aspect of baptism. In addition to this aspect, there is an individual aspect, which is the application and realization of, and participation in, the corporate baptism (Acts 10:47-48; 2:38, 41; 16:33; 19:5; Matt. 28:19; Gal. 3:27-28).

zh: 身体这许多的讲究，其源头乃是圣灵—经过过程之三一神的终极完成—的浇灌。在已过的永远，我们的神是三一的，但还没有经过过程。祂借着成为肉体，开始经过过程。祂借着钉死在十字架上，继续经过过程。祂借着从死亡和阴间里复活，更进一步的经过过程。祂在升天里完成了祂所经过的过程。现今祂是经过过程的三一神。祂这位经过过程的三一神，将自己浇灌下来，作为圣灵，把所有祂拣选的人，就是在基督里的信徒，浸成一个身体。这个身体第一乃是基督的身体，其次是基督的新妇，其次是宇宙的新人，其次是神的家人，或神的家庭，再其次是神的殿，就是神的居所。
en: The source of these aspects of the Body is the outpouring of the Holy Spirit, who is the consummation of the processed Triune God. In eternity past, our God was triune, but He was not yet processed. He began to be processed by being incarnated. He continued His process by being crucified on the cross. He was processed further by being resurrected from death and Hades. He completed His process in His ascension. Now He is the processed Triune God. As the processed Triune God, He poured Himself out as the Holy Spirit to baptize all His chosen ones, the believers in Christ, into one Body. This Body is first the Body of Christ, then the bride of Christ, then the universal new man, then God's household or God's family, and then God's temple, which is God's habitation.

norm_en: The source of these aspects of the Body is the outpouring of the Holy Spirit who is the consummation of the processed Triune God In eternity past our God was triune but He was not yet processed He began to be processed by being incarnated He continued His process by being crucified on the cross He was processed further by being resurrected from death and Hades He completed His process in His ascension Now He is the processed Triune God As the processed Triune God He poured Himself out as the Holy Spirit to baptize all His chosen ones the believers in Christ into one Body This Body is first the Body of Christ then the bride of Christ then the universal new man then Gods household or Gods family and then Gods temple which is Gods habitation

zh: 诸天的国是有关基督身体的最后一项，这身体是五旬节那日由圣灵的浇灌所构成的。圣灵（就是终极完成的三一神）的浇灌是为着将所有信徒浸成一个身体。在新约里，国度含示神的国和诸天的国。这些不是一个，乃是两个东西。它们是国度的两方面。
en: The kingdom of the heavens is the last item related to the Body that was constituted by the outpouring of the Spirit on the day of Pentecost. The outpouring of the Holy Spirit as the consummated Triune God was for the baptizing of all the believers into one Body. In the New Testament, the kingdom implies the kingdom of God and the kingdom of the heavens. These are not one, but two things. They are two aspects of the kingdom.

zh: 在新约里，国度是一件复杂的事。譬如，新约有些部分指明，即使在使徒时代，神的国还是将来要来临的，（徒十四22下，林前六9~10，十五50）而新约别的部分却指明神的国现今已经存在。（罗十四17，林前四20，西四11下）因此，我们不容易认识圣经中有关国度的真理。按照新约的教训，我们必须将神的国和诸天的国分类为两件不同的事。在本篇信息里，我们要说到神的国。（李常受文集一九九〇年第一册，使徒的教训，第四篇）
en: In the New Testament the kingdom is a complicated matter. For example, certain portions of the New Testament indicate that even at the time of the apostles the kingdom of God was something that would come in the future (Acts 14:22b; 1 Cor. 6:9-10; 15:50); whereas other portions of the New Testament indicate that it is present now (Rom. 14:17; 1 Cor. 4:20; Col. 4:11b). Thus, it is not easy to know the truth concerning the kingdom in the Bible. According to the New Testament teaching, we must classify the kingdom of God and the kingdom of the heavens as two different, particular matters. In this message we shall cover the kingdom of God.

zh: 人需要重生，也是为着进神的国。因为人若不重生，就不能见神的国，就不能进神的国。神的国是属灵的，看见神这属灵的国，就等于进神的国。重生乃是人这样进神的国惟一的入门。神的国乃是神之所是的范围，犹如植物国度是植物之所是的范围，动物国度是动物之所是的范围。没有植物，就没有植物国度；没有动物，就没有动物国度。人之所是和神之所是，根本是不同的，是在两个不同的范围，两个不同的国里。要进入人的国，就必须从人生，有人的生命；照样，要进入神的国，就必须从神生，有神的生命。所以人必须从神生，就是重生，好得着神的生命，能进入神的国。（生命课程，第四十二课）
en: Man also needs to be regenerated in order to enter into the kingdom of God. Unless a man is regenerated, he cannot see the kingdom of God, nor can he enter into it. The kingdom of God is spiritual, and to see this spiritual kingdom of God is to enter into it. Regeneration is the unique entrance through which man enters into God's kingdom. The kingdom of God is the realm of what God is, just as the plant kingdom is the realm of what plants are, and the animal kingdom is the realm of what animals are. Without plants there is no plant kingdom, and without animals there is no animal kingdom. What man is and what God is are basically different, being in two different realms and in two different kingdoms. In order to enter into the human kingdom, one must be born of man to have the human life; likewise, in order to enter into God's kingdom, one must be born of God to have God's life. Therefore, man must be born of God, that is, he must be regenerated that he may have God's life and may enter into the kingdom of God. (Life Lessons, Lesson 42)

zh: 壹	行传四章三十三节，“使徒大有能力，见证主耶稣的复活，众人也都蒙大恩”；说这恩是基督，太简单了；这不仅仅是基督，乃是行动的基督、作工的基督、掌权的基督、使人信服的基督、征服一切的基督、施行拯救的基督、和将人拔高的基督：（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: I. Acts 4:33, "With great power the apostles gave testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and great grace was upon them all"; to say that this grace was Christ is too simple; it was not merely Christ but Christ moving, Christ working, Christ reigning, Christ convincing, Christ subduing, Christ saving, and Christ uplifting:
norm_zh: 壹行传四章三十三节使徒大有能力见证主耶稣的复活众人也都蒙大恩说这恩是基督太简单了这不仅仅是基督乃是行动的基督作工的基督掌权的基督使人信服的基督征服一切的基督施行拯救的基督和将人拔高的基督李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第二章
norm_en: I Acts 433 With great power the apostles gave testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus and great grace was upon them all to say that this grace was Christ is too simple it was not merely Christ but Christ moving Christ working Christ reigning Christ convincing Christ subduing Christ saving and Christ uplifting

zh: 一	首先，我们必然看见恩典是一个人位，神圣而属人的人位，这一个人位既神圣又属人；这人位原在永远里，而后进入时间里；祂成了人，活在地上，死于十字架，从死人中复活，升上诸天，并且登宝座、得荣耀、且受托以宇宙中所有的权柄（太二八18）；这样的人位作为恩典降临，眷临祂所有的信徒。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: A. First, of course, we see that grace is a person, a divine-human person, a person who is divine as well as human; this person was in eternity, and He came into time; He became a man who lived on the earth, died on the cross, rose from the dead, ascended into the heavens, and was enthroned, glorified, and entrusted with all the authority in the universe (Matt. 28:18); such a person came down as grace to visit all His believers.
norm_zh: 一首先我们必然看见恩典是一个人位神圣而属人的人位这一个人位既神圣又属人这人位原在永远里而后进入时间里祂成了人活在地上死于十字架从死人中复活升上诸天并且登宝座得荣耀且受托以宇宙中所有的权柄太二八18这样的人位作为恩典降临眷临祂所有的信徒李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第二章
norm_en: A First of course we see that grace is a person a divinehuman person a person who is divine as well as human this person was in eternity and He came into time He became a man who lived on the earth died on the cross rose from the dead ascended into the heavens and was enthroned glorified and entrusted with all the authority in the universe Matt 2818 such a person came down as grace to visit all His believers

zh: 二	我们能看见，恩典也是这奇妙人位所赐给的，以及这奇妙人位所成就的—林后十二9，林前十五10。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: B. We can see that grace is also something given by this wonderful person and something done by this wonderful person—2 Cor. 12:9; 1 Cor. 15:10.

norm_en: B We can see that grace is also something given by this wonderful person and something done by this wonderful person2 Cor 129 1 Cor 1510

en: II. Grace is able to produce a situation in which grace can be seen by people—Acts 11:23; 1 Cor. 14:25:

zh: 一	巴拿巴来到安提阿，在那里看见神的恩典；有犹太信徒和外邦信徒来在一起赞美神，并且在基督里是一—徒十一23，林前十四25。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: A. Barnabas came to Antioch, and there he saw the grace of God; there the Jewish believers and the Gentile believers had come together to praise God and to be one in Christ—Acts 11:23; 1 Cor. 14:25.
norm_zh: 一巴拿巴来到安提阿在哪里看见神的恩典有犹太信徒和外邦信徒来在一起赞美神并且在基督里是一徒十一23林前十四25李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第二章
norm_en: A Barnabas came to Antioch and there he saw the grace of God there the Jewish believers and the Gentile believers had come together to praise God and to be one in ChristActs 1123 1 Cor 1425

zh: 二	倘若我们是外人，来到在安提阿的召会，就和巴拿巴一样，看见许多脸发光，许多口赞美神，我们只能说，“恩典，恩典！”看见恩典是美妙的；恩典应当见于我们所有的召会聚会—徒十一23，林前十四25。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: B. If we came to the church in Antioch as a stranger, as Barnabas did, and saw many faces glowing with many mouths praising God, we could only say, "Grace, Grace!" It is wonderful to see grace; grace should be seen in all our church meetings—Acts 11:23; 1 Cor. 14:25.
norm_zh: 二倘若我们是外人来到在安提阿的召会就和巴拿巴一样看见许多脸发光许多口赞美神我们只能说恩典恩典看见恩典是美妙的恩典应当见于我们所有的召会聚会徒十一23林前十四25李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第二章
norm_en: B If we came to the church in Antioch as a stranger as Barnabas did and saw many faces glowing with many mouths praising God we could only say Grace Grace It is wonderful to see grace grace should be seen in all our church meetingsActs 1123 1 Cor 1425

zh: 三	或许你很受压，感觉非常低落；你可能来到召会的聚会中，就发觉满了恩典；然后你也许开始深深感觉，有东西流进你里面；若是这样，你就会得着安慰、鼓励和盼望—徒十一23，林前十四25。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: C. Perhaps you are depressed and feel very low; you may come to a meeting of the church and find that it is full of grace; then you may begin to have the deep sensation that something is flowing into you; if this is the case, you will receive comfort, encouragement, and hope—Acts 11:23; 1 Cor. 14:25.
norm_zh: 三或许你很受压感觉非常低落你可能来到召会的聚会中就发觉满了恩典然后你也许开始深深感觉有东西流进你里面若是这样你就会得着安慰鼓励和盼望徒十一23林前十四25李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第二章
norm_en: C Perhaps you are depressed and feel very low you may come to a meeting of the church and find that it is full of grace then you may begin to have the deep sensation that something is flowing into you if this is the case you will receive comfort encouragement and hopeActs 1123 1 Cor 1425

zh: 四	真实的恩典就是耶稣自己；祂不计任何代价的为我们行事，祂也不计代价的把东西赐给我们；恩典就是耶稣连同祂恩典的作为和祂恩典的赐给—约一14、16~17。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: D. The real grace is Jesus Himself; He does things for us without any cost, and He gives things to us without any cost; grace is Jesus with His gracious doing and His gracious giving—John 1:14, 16-17.
norm_zh: 四真实的恩典就是耶稣自己祂不计任何代价的为我们行事祂也不计代价的把东西赐给我们恩典就是耶稣连同祂恩典的作为和祂恩典的赐给约一141617李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第二章
norm_en: D The real grace is Jesus Himself He does things for us without any cost and He gives things to us without any cost grace is Jesus with His gracious doing and His gracious givingJohn 114 1617

zh: 一	无论保罗往那里去，主耶稣都与他同在，一直给与、扶持、分授、供应，并借着保罗作许多事；那就是恩典—40节，弗三8。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: A. Wherever Paul went, the Lord Jesus was with him, giving, supporting, imparting, supplying, and doing many things through Paul; that was grace—v. 40; Eph. 3:8.

norm_en: A Wherever Paul went the Lord Jesus was with him giving supporting imparting supplying and doing many things through Paul that was gracev 40 Eph 38

zh: 二	保罗作工，不是凭着他的教育、才能或智慧，乃是凭着神的恩典；这意思就是，保罗凭着一个奇妙的人位耶稣，作了一切奇妙的工作；耶稣将祂一切的丰富分授到保罗里面，并借着保罗成就许多事—8节。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: B. Paul worked not by his education, his ability, or his wisdom but by the grace of God; this simply means that Paul did all his wonderful work by a wonderful person, Jesus, who imparted all His riches into Paul and accomplished much through Paul.—v. 8.
norm_zh: 二保罗作工不是凭着他的教育才能或智慧乃是凭着神的恩典这意思就是保罗凭着一个奇妙的人位耶稣作了一切奇妙的工作耶稣将祂一切的丰富分授到保罗里面并借着保罗成就许多事8节李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第二章
norm_en: B Paul worked not by his education his ability or his wisdom but by the grace of God this simply means that Paul did all his wonderful work by a wonderful person Jesus who imparted all His riches into Paul and accomplished much through Paulv 8

zh: 三	我们没有借口；我们都必须尽功用，因为基督的恩典是够用的；我们不但该学习说，“不再是我，乃是基督，”也该说，“不是我，乃是恩典”；我们都必须学习不信靠我们自己，乃信靠神的恩—林前十五10，加二20。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: C. We have no excuse; we all must function, because the grace of Christ is sufficient; we should learn to say not only "No longer I but Christ" but also "Not I but grace"; we all must learn not to trust in ourselves but in the grace of God.—1 Cor. 15:10; Gal. 2:20.

norm_en: C We have no excuse we all must function because the grace of Christ is sufficient we should learn to say not only No longer I but Christ but also Not I but grace we all must learn not to trust in ourselves but in the grace of God1 Cor 1510 Gal 220

zh: 肆	保罗说恩典洋溢，恩典也作王掌权；恩典若不是一个人位，怎能作王掌权？赞美主，恩典是王—罗五20~21：（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: IV. Paul says that grace has abounded and that grace reigns as a king; if grace were not a person, how could grace reign as a king? Praise the Lord that grace is a king.—Rom. 5:20-21:
norm_zh: 肆保罗说恩典洋溢恩典也作王掌权恩典若不是一个人位怎能作王掌权赞美主恩典是王罗五2021李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第二章
norm_en: IV Paul says that grace has abounded and that grace reigns as a king if grace were not a person how could grace reign as a king Praise the Lord that grace is a kingRom 52021

zh: 一	恩典作王管理撒但，管理罪，管理肉体，管理死，并管理宇宙中一切消极的事物；所以，恩典无疑就是主耶稣，也是耶稣这活的人位，赐给我们所需要的一切，并作成神所要求的一切—20~21节。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: A. Grace reigns over Satan, over sin, over the flesh, over death, and over all the negative things in the universe; therefore, grace is no doubt the Lord Jesus, and it is also Jesus, the living person, giving us whatever we need and doing whatever God requires.—vv. 20-21.
norm_zh: 一恩典作王管理撒但管理罪管理肉体管理死并管理宇宙中一切消极的事物所以恩典无疑就是主耶稣也是耶稣这活的人位赐给我们所需要的一切并作成神所要求的一切2021节李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第二章
norm_en: A Grace reigns over Satan over sin over the flesh over death and over all the negative things in the universe therefore grace is no doubt the Lord Jesus and it is also Jesus the living person giving us whatever we need and doing whatever God requiresvv 2021

zh: 二	神说，人若犯罪就必死（一32，六23上）；但基督来为我们死（五8）；这是耶稣恩典的作为；我们因恩典，因耶稣恩典的作为得称义。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: B. God says that if man sins, he must die (1:32; 6:23a); but Christ came and died for us (5:8); this is the gracious doing of Jesus; we have been justified by grace, by the gracious doing of Jesus.

norm_en: B God says that if man sins he must die 132 623a but Christ came and died for us 58 this is the gracious doing of Jesus we have been justified by grace by the gracious doing of Jesus

zh: 三	我们呼求主，就经历甜美的享受，并且我们呼求祂，祂就成为我们里面的恩典无论我们需要什么，祂都供应；无论神要求我们什么，祂都应付；我们只需要作一件事：享受恩典—哀三55。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: C. When we call on the Lord, we experience a sweet enjoyment, and as we call on Him, He becomes grace within us; whatever we need, He supplies; whatever God requires of us, He meets that requirement; all we need to do is enjoy grace.—Lam. 3:55.

norm_en: C When we call on the Lord we experience a sweet enjoyment and as we call on Him He becomes grace within us whatever we need He supplies whatever God requires of us He meets that requirement all we need to do is enjoy graceLam 355

zh: 一	我们享受越多恩典，就得着越多恩赐；我们若在恩典上贫穷，在恩赐上也必然贫穷—罗十二6，林前十五9~10。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: A. The more grace we enjoy, the more gifts we will have; if we are poor in grace, surely we will be poor in gifts.—Rom. 12:6; 1 Cor. 15:9-10.
norm_zh: 一我们享受越多恩典就得着越多恩赐我们若在恩典上贫穷在恩赐上也必然贫穷罗十二6林前十五910李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第二章
norm_en: A The more grace we enjoy the more gifts we will have if we are poor in grace surely we will be poor in giftsRom 126 1 Cor 15910

zh: 二	这些恩赐不是来自我们的教育，也不是来自我们在圣经学校或神学院里的学习；这些恩赐来自恩典；我们越享受恩典，就越有出于这恩典的属灵恩赐；我们越享受基督的恩典，就越能为基督说话，并为祂行事—罗十二6，林前十五9~10。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第二章）
en: B. These gifts do not come from our education or from our learning in a Bible school or a seminary; these gifts come from grace; the more we enjoy grace, the more we will have spiritual gifts out of this grace; the more we enjoy the grace of Christ, the more we will be able to speak for Christ and do something for Him.—Rom. 12:6; 1 Cor. 15:9-10.
norm_zh: 二这些恩赐不是来自我们的教育也不是来自我们在圣经学校或神学院里的学习这些恩赐来自恩典我们越享受恩典就越有出于这恩典的属灵恩赐我们越享受基督的恩典就越能为基督说话并为祂行事罗十二6林前十五910李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第二章
norm_en: B These gifts do not come from our education or from our learning in a Bible school or a seminary these gifts come from grace the more we enjoy grace the more we will have spiritual gifts out of this grace the more we enjoy the grace of Christ the more we will be able to speak for Christ and do something for HimRom 126 1 Cor 15910

zh: 2	我们无法凭自己排除里面的老旧；排除一切老旧最好的路，就是把耶稣接受进来；借着我们呼吸、吃、喝耶稣，属天和神圣的元素就进入我们里面；这元素会使我们得着新陈代谢的变化—林后五17，加六15，西三10~11，林后三18。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第五章）
en: 2. By ourselves there is no way for us to discharge the oldness that is in us; the best way to discharge all the oldness is to take Jesus in; through our breathing, eating, and drinking of Jesus, the heavenly and divine element enters into us; this element will cause us to be metabolically transformed.—2 Cor. 5:17; Gal. 6:15; Col. 3:10-11; 2 Cor. 3:18.
norm_zh: 2我们无法凭自己排除里面的老旧排除一切老旧最好的路就是把耶稣接受进来借着我们呼吸吃喝耶稣属天和神圣的元素就进入我们里面这元素会使我们得着新陈代谢的变化林后五17加六15西三1011林后三18李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第五章
norm_en: 2 By ourselves there is no way for us to discharge the oldness that is in us the best way to discharge all the oldness is to take Jesus in through our breathing eating and drinking of Jesus the heavenly and divine element enters into us this element will cause us to be metabolically transformed2 Cor 517 Gal 615 Col 31011 2 Cor 318

en: III. Overcoming Our Peculiarity through TransformationIV. Overcoming Our Peculiarity through Transformation—Rom. 8:2, 29; 1 John 3:2:
norm_zh: 叁借着变化胜过我们的乖僻罗八229约壹三2李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第五章
norm_en: III Overcoming Our Peculiarity through TransformationIV Overcoming Our Peculiarity through TransformationRom 82 29 1 John 32

zh: 一	我们都有自己天然的构成；照着这构成，我们永远无法与别人是一；我们因着乖僻而有的难处越多，享受基督的机会就越多—林前二14~16。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第五章）
en: A. We all have our own natural constitution; according to this constitution, we could never be one with others; the more trouble we have because of our peculiarities, the more opportunities we have to enjoy Christ.—1 Cor. 2:14-16.
norm_zh: 一我们都有自己天然的构成照着这构成我们永远无法与别人是一我们因着乖僻而有的难处越多享受基督的机会就越多林前二1416李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第五章
norm_en: A We all have our own natural constitution according to this constitution we could never be one with others the more trouble we have because of our peculiarities the more opportunities we have to enjoy Christ1 Cor 21416

zh: 二	被变化的路就是呼求耶稣的名并祷读祂的话，好将祂接受进来；姊妹们若行这些事，主耶稣就会在她们里面作变化的工作；祂不会仅仅改正她们，乃会变化她们；祂会以祂自己顶替她们—约六35、57、63，耶十五16，弗六17~18。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第五章）
en: B. The way to be transformed is to call on the name of Jesus and pray-read His Word in order to take Him in; if the sisters will do these things, the Lord Jesus will do a transforming work within them; He will not merely correct them but will transform them; He will replace them with Himself.—John 6:35, 57, 63; Jer. 15:16; Eph. 6:17-18.
norm_zh: 二被变化的路就是呼求耶稣的名并祷读祂的话好将祂接受进来姊妹们若行这些事主耶稣就会在她们里面作变化的工作祂不会仅仅改正她们乃会变化她们祂会以祂自己顶替她们约六355763耶十五16弗六1718李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第五章
norm_en: B The way to be transformed is to call on the name of Jesus and prayread His Word in order to take Him in if the sisters will do these things the Lord Jesus will do a transforming work within them He will not merely correct them but will transform them He will replace them with HimselfJohn 635 57 63 Jer 1516 Eph 61718

zh: 三	经过变化的姊妹适合与别人一同被建造；她无论在哪里，不管在家庭里，在姊妹之家里，或在召会的圣徒当中，都不会与任何人有难处—罗八16，十二1~2、4~5。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第五章）
en: C. A transformed sister is fit to be built up with others; wherever she is, whether in a family, in a sisters' house, or among the saints in the church, she will have no problem with anyone.—Rom. 8:16; 12:1-2, 4-5.
norm_zh: 三经过变化的姊妹适合与别人一同被建造她无论在哪里不管在家庭里在姊妹之家里或在召会的圣徒当中都不会与任何人有难处罗八16十二1245李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第五章
norm_en: C A transformed sister is fit to be built up with others wherever she is whether in a family in a sisters house or among the saints in the church she will have no problem with anyoneRom 816 1212 45

zh: 四	信徒经过变化以后，就变得非常有弹性，能适合任何一种情况，并且能与任何一种信徒一同被建造；这样的人适合建造—八16，十二1~2、4~5。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第五章）
en: D. After being transformed, a believer becomes very flexible; he is_ able to fit into any kind of situation and be built with any kind of believer; such a person is fit for the building.—Rom. 8:16; 12:1-2, 4-5.
norm_zh: 四信徒经过变化以后就变得非常有弹性能适合任何一种情况并且能与任何一种信徒一同被建造这样的人适合建造八16十二1245李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第五章
norm_en: D After being transformed a believer becomes very flexible he is_ able to fit into any kind of situation and be built with any kind of believer such a person is fit for the buildingRom 816 1212 45

en: IV. TRANSFORMED AND BUILT UP FOR THE INCREASE AND SPREAD OF THE CHURCH—Gen. 32:28; 35:10, 15:

norm_en: IV TRANSFORMED AND BUILT UP FOR THE INCREASE AND SPREAD OF THE CHURCHGen 3228 3510 15

zh: 一	弟兄们若对主认真，并且是真实寻求主和纯诚爱主的人，就会到主面前去迫切祷告，不但为着自己的变化祷告，也为着召会的扩增祷告—罗八28~29，十二2。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第五章）
en: A. If the brothers mean business with the Lord and are genuine seekers and sincere lovers of the Lord, they will go to the Lord and pray desperately not only for their transformation but also for the increase of the church.—Rom. 8:28-29; 12:2.
norm_zh: 一弟兄们若对主认真并且是真实寻求主和纯诚爱主的人就会到主面前去迫切祷告不但为着自己的变化祷告也为着召会的扩增祷告罗八2829十二2李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第五章
norm_en: A If the brothers mean business with the Lord and are genuine seekers and sincere lovers of the Lord they will go to the Lord and pray desperately not only for their transformation but also for the increase of the churchRom 82829 122

zh: 二	我鼓励姊妹们更多的接受基督进来，作她们的享受，我也告诫弟兄们要有迫切的态度，与主彻底的办交涉；弟兄们需要告诉主：“主，我不要不冷不热或冷淡！我要火热！我要焚烧！”我们当中需要建造，而建造来自变化—八28~29，十二2。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第五章）
en: B. I encourage the sisters to take in more of Christ for their enjoyment, and I admonish the brothers to have a thorough dealing with the Lord with an attitude of desperation; the brothers need to tell the Lord, "Lord, I don't want to be lukewarm or cold! I want to be hot! I want to be burning!" Among us we need the building, and the building comes from transformation.—Rom. 8:28-29; 12:2.
norm_zh: 二我鼓励姊妹们更多的接受基督进来作她们的享受我也告诫弟兄们要有迫切的态度与主彻底的办交涉弟兄们需要告诉主主我不要不冷不热或冷淡我要火热我要焚烧我们当中需要建造而建造来自变化八2829十二2李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第五章
norm_en: B I encourage the sisters to take in more of Christ for their enjoyment and I admonish the brothers to have a thorough dealing with the Lord with an attitude of desperation the brothers need to tell the Lord Lord I dont want to be lukewarm or cold I want to be hot I want to be burning Among us we need the building and the building comes from transformationRom 82829 122

zh: 三	我们不该忘记，享受恩典是为着在生命里长大，在生命里长大是为着变化，变化终极完成于建造，而建造是为着主见证的扩增与扩展—罗十二2，启二一18上。（李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册，新约中的恩典，第五章）
en: C. We should not forget that the enjoyment of grace is for the growth in life, the growth in life is for transformation, transformation consummates in the building, and the building is for the increase and spread of the Lord's testimony.—Rom. 12:2; Rev. 21:18a.
norm_zh: 三我们不该忘记享受恩典是为着在生命里长大在生命里长大是为着变化变化终极完成于建造而建造是为着主见证的扩增与扩展罗十二2启二一18上李常受文集一九七三至一九七四年第一册新约中的恩典第五章
